title: Website Developer (Full Stack)
description:
**About Us**

Great Impressions is a creative advertising agency specialising in strategy\-led marketing, brand development, and powerful visual storytelling. We craft compelling, design\-forward websites that are supported by robust development and seamless digital infrastructure. We are seeking a highly skilled, technically proficient website developer to join our team and help bring our creative visions to life.

**Position Overview**

We are looking for a *Website Developer* who excels at turning design concepts into functional, high\-performance websites. You’ll work closely with our in\-house creative director and graphic designers to build websites based on approved designs, ranging from custom builds to template\-based solutions. The ideal candidate will possess a comprehensive understanding of modern web development, hosting environments, email configurations, and excellent communication skills.

**Key Responsibilities Website Development**

* Build and maintain websites in WordPress using Divi, WPBakery, Elementor, and custom themes.
* Develop websites in Wix, Shopify, and pure HTML/CSS/JS when required.
* Translate design mockups into pixel\-perfect, responsive websites.
* Create and manage child themes and custom WordPress themes.

**Coding \& Technical Proficiency**

* Write clean, well\-documented, and efficient code.
* Work across a wide range of code environments (see required technologies below).
* Troubleshoot and resolve front\-end and back\-end bugs quickly.
* Implement advanced plugin setups, including WooCommerce, shipping integrations (UPS, FedEx), and third\-party feature plugins.

**Hosting \& Server Management**

* Set up and manage websites on various hosting platforms, including cPanel\-based and proprietary servers.
* Manage server file systems, backups, and SFTP\-based deployments.
* Configure and manage domain hosting, redirects, and SSL certificates.
* Setup and work with SSH and other APIs with AI intagration.

**Email \& DNS Configuration**

* Set up and manage email environments in cPanel, Google Workspace, and Microsoft 365\.
* Configure and troubleshoot domain DNS settings including MX, SPF, DKIM, and TXT records.
* Assist clients in migrating and managing email solutions.

**Collaboration \& Support**

* Collaborate with designers, copywriters, and project managers to ensure timely delivery.
* Make informed plugin recommendations and quickly learn how to implement unfamiliar tools or systems.
* Communicate clearly and professionally with team members.
* Provide technical support and maintenance for completed sites.

**Required Skills \& Technologies, Core Development Skills**

* HTML5, CSS3
* JavaScript (vanilla \+ jQuery)
* PHP
* MySQL
* JSON, XML

**CMS \& Platforms**

* WordPress (Divi, Elementor, WPBakery, Custom themes)
* Shopify (theme customization and apps)
* Wix (customization and embedding code)
* Basic familiarity with Squarespace or Webflow is a plus

**Server \& Hosting**

* cPanel / WHM
* FTP / SFTP clients (e.g., FileZilla, Cyberduck)
* DNS configuration and domain setup
* SSL, security protocols, and file permissions
* SSH with AI

**Email Configuration**

* Google Workspace (Gmail setup, alias, forwarding, etc.)
* Microsoft 365 (Exchange, setup, integration)
* cPanel email setup and troubleshooting

**Bonus Skills**

* Git version control
* Familiarity with CLI commands and server\-side scripting
* Experience with staging environments and site migrations
* Site performance optimization and security hardening

**What We’re Looking For**

* Exceptional attention to detail
* Self\-starter with strong problem\-solving skills
* Proven ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines
* Outstanding English communication (written and verbal)
* Proactive attitude and a drive to learn new tools and technologies

**Timings**  
You will be working with our creative director in the US. You need to be available for live Teams conversations betweem 9:00 AM and 12: 00 PM Eastern Standard Time.

Given how important websites are to our clients, you need to be on call for emergencies between 12:00 PM and 5:00 PM Eastern Standard Time.

We try to avoing working at weekends, but again, if it is an emergency, you need to be on call.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹50,000\.00 \- ₹65,000\.83 per month

Benefits:

* Paid time off
* Work from home

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Experience:

* Web development: 4 years (Required)

Work Location: Remote
